**A TANNAKIAN DESCRIPTION OF THE LOCAL KALETHA GERBE**

*ALEXANDER BERTOLONI MELI AND PETER DILLERY*

26 pp, 16 sections.

**Abstract.** We construct, for ap-adic fieldF, an explicit semisimple Tannakian categoryRigIsoc F whose category of fiber functors recovers Kaletha’s Galois gerbeE Kal. We then classify and write down the simple objects inRigIsoc F , all of which come from elliptic twisted Levi subgroups ofGLn.
